name: BidSkim
description:
BidSkim gives your AI assistant direct access to UK public procurement intelligence — the same engine behind bidskim.com.

Ask which contracts in your space expire in the next six months and who holds them, find live tenders that fit what you do, and pull buyer or supplier histories on demand.

Eight read-only tools:
• Search live tenders by keyword, CPV code, region, value and deadline — every UK source (Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, PCS, Sell2Wales), deduplicated to one record per opportunity
• Renewal intelligence: awarded contracts likely to re-tender within 24 months, with expiry dates, incumbent suppliers, recurrence evidence, required certifications and TUPE flags
• Buyer profiles: spend history, top suppliers, upcoming renewals
• Supplier profiles: contracts won, buyers served, current incumbencies
• Meaning-based search that finds tenders which never use your keywords
• Your own pipeline: AI-scored matches with reasoning, saved tenders, tracked suppliers

Everything is read-only and scoped to your BidSkim account. Connections use OAuth against your existing BidSkim login — no separate credentials. Sensible daily budgets keep responses fast; tool arguments are never stored.

Requires a BidSkim account on the Predict plan (bidskim.com/pricing). Setup guide: bidskim.com/mcp

_published_faq.name: How do I add BidSkim to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BidSkim to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bidskim.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BidSkim MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BidSkim provides these MCP tools: get_buyer, get_supplier, get_tender, my_pipeline, search_organisations, search_renewals, search_tenders, and semantic_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BidSkim?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BidSkim in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
BidSkim requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BidSkim is developed by BidSkim. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
